source.rule: A five-block bridge functions if any of UL+UR, LL+LR, UL+BR+LR, or LL+BR+UR functions.

configuration.common: Accepted five physical positions and LRUs, A/B OPHOURS failure modes, half-hour direct system CM, G04-OPS mission h8–34, seed1, one replication, horizon36.
configuration.parent_allbroken: UL=B, LL=A, BR=E, UR=C, LR=D; B failure leaves routes but A failure breaks all four routes.
configuration.brfirst: UL=E, LL=A, BR=B, UR=C, LR=D; B bridge-block failure leaves both direct routes, A failure leaves UL+UR.
configuration.comparator_ulur: UL=C, LL=B, BR=A, UR=D, LR=E; A bridge-block failure second leaves UL+UR.

pre_run_hypotheses: The guarded native import/export exactly preserves all 22 populated tables and calculates with zero errors or unreviewed diagnostics.
B fails the bridge block at h8.62763 while both direct paths remain; A later fails LL at h16.7498 while UL+UR remains. Both failures are noncritical and the mission succeeds at h34.

Matched accepted allbroken makes A critical and aborts at h16.7498; accepted ulur makes the second A bridge-block failure noncritical and succeeds. Native logs report system criticality, not an active bridge path label.
native_acceptance: Unique guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table import/export roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Matched B/A timeline and expected criticality/mission outcome, 72-bin report, CM/stock/terminal reconciliation, and independent read-only replay.
diagnostic_gate: Preserve any rejected or unmatched run as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID.
limits: One fixed-seed first bridge-block failure and accepted second bridge-block failure comparator; not a full bridge reliability truth table or population estimate.
The native event log does not label the active bridge path; path identity is inferred from sealed source and manual rule. No nested bridge, online maintenance, GUI RBD drawing or cross-engine claim.
